visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh","status":"insufficient_evidence","nature":"insufficient_evidence","category":"event_status","severity":"medium","explanation":"日志只证明开始铸造，未记录是否完成；草稿将“已铸成”归于日志，缺少完成记录。","reasoning":"所引证据仅记载沈砚于初五开始铸造，并明确此后没有记录铸造是否完成。它支持“开始铸造”，却不包含“铸成”这一结果；草稿声称日志可证明已经铸成，缺的正是从开工到完成的完成记录。判断因此停在“铸成未知”，既不能确认铸成，也不构成直接矛盾。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":null,"evidence_anchor":"初五","relation":"unknown"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh-G1","span_id":"cc-span-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh-G1","relation":"context","sufficiency":"insufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh-G1"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"cc-span-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh-G1","role":"missing_link"}],"suggested_revision":null,"available_actions":[]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc7-outcome-unknown-zh","verdict":"insufficient_evidence","basis":"草稿断言日志证明铜钟已铸成，但日志仅记载初五开始铸造，并明确此后未记录是否完成；缺少完成记录，归属无据，既不能确认也不能否认铸成。"}]}
